objective: 实测从真实汉字设计师理论中抽象的‘按结构密度调整整部件比例及字内留白’，而非R1-R8的笔宽/起收笔/重心单指标。

provenance.author: 徐学成
original_principles: 左紧右松/部件阔狭按照笔画多少变化

provenance.author: 字由（安晴的姐姐）
original_principles: 先修正各字结构，再用共享偏旁形成联系
某些内部负空间过大时移动部件
右侧部件需同步处理以免割裂

dataset.license: Arphic Public License; raw glyph stroke outlines source pinned, no creator intent claimed

structural_family: both characters have 3-stroke left 氵 radical as first 3 annotated strokes

controls.definition: original actual HanziWriter stroke outlines, fitted to identical 1000-unit visual cell
naive fixed-width whole-component allocation, left radical nominal width 23% of normalized cell, right remainder; same equal gap for all characters

density-conditioned whole-component planning: sparse right <=5 strokes radical width 28%; medium 6-8 width 24%; dense >=9 width 19.5%; position both semantic components with source-preserving outline path scaling and 28-unit gap. Every right component independently gets remaining width. No per-stroke thickness/operator changes.

design_operator.target_bands: left band starts at x70, width=ratio*870. Right starts leftEnd+28, extends to x940. Affine fit of actual per-stroke glyph outlines. No thickness/texture changes.
design_operator.abstention: No shared 3-stroke left 氵 in both glyphs: emit A unchanged and explicit NO_APPLY, no coercion.

validity_gates: Each target literal simplified Chinese glyph and raw stroke count verified against source SHA
Target words must be absent from source study examples and structural tuning
No source character from holdout used to tune thresholds or decision
Equal output dimensions, same exact characters and underlying brush outline data
C must differ from naive B due to right-side component density, not typography label
Whole-component contour is changed, not path thickness or effect overlay
For negative control where no shared left 氵, C abstains instead of silently applying
Check actual target codepoints, source strokes, no clipping, visible gap, raster hashes, silhouette identity
Independent human aesthetic review separate from structure metrics; no production claim
unknowns: Does simple split of radicals preserve real structural dynamics?
Whether C makes visually better artwork; mathematical gap guarantee is not beauty
Might look like ordinary printed glyphs; not necessarily brush expression
success_def: Only actual visual aesthetic improvement in previously unseen words AND independent human review can promote any creator-method claim.
